name: LINE Messaging API
description: Send push, reply and broadcast messages from a LINE Official Account, the main chat app in Japan, Taiwan and Thailand, and check the bot, its monthly message quota and user profiles. The free plan includes a monthly number of push messages (it varies by country); replies are free.
instructions:
This connector uses the LINE Messaging API v2.

**Creating a channel**: log in to https://developers.line.biz/console → create a Provider → 'Create a new channel' → 'Messaging API'. Set up the LINE Official Account (auto-created with the channel), then under the channel's 'Messaging API' tab, scroll to 'Channel access token' → 'Issue' a long-lived token. Paste it as `LINE_CHANNEL_ACCESS_TOKEN`.

**Authentication**: Bearer Token (the channel access token). Note: this token belongs to the channel, not to a user — anyone with the token can post as that Official Account, so keep it secret.

**Message shape**: LINE messages are objects with a `type` field. Simplest example: `{"type": "text", "text": "Hello"}`. Other types: `sticker`, `image`, `video`, `audio`, `location`, `template`, `flex`. The `messages` parameter on every tool is an **array of up to 5** message objects.

**`to` userId**: a userId is `U` followed by 32 hex characters. It comes from a webhook event (this connector does not receive webhooks, so the user has to give it to you) or, on verified and premium accounts, from `line_list_follower_ids`. A display name is not a userId, and a made-up one fails with "The value for the 'userId' parameter is invalid".

**`replyToken`**: returned in webhook events, single-use, valid for about a minute after the user's message. Never call `line_reply_message` with a placeholder: LINE answers "Invalid reply token". Without a fresh token, push instead. Use `line_reply_message` (free, unlimited) instead of `line_push_message` (counts against the monthly quota) whenever possible.

**Broadcast**: sends to ALL friends of the Official Account. Counts heavily against the push quota — use sparingly.

**Pricing**: the free plan includes a monthly number of push and broadcast messages that depends on the country (for example 200 in Japan); paid plans raise it. `line_get_message_quota` returns the account's own limit.

**Before sending**: `line_get_bot_info` checks the token, `line_get_message_quota` and `line_get_message_quota_consumption` show how much of the monthly push quota is left. Push and broadcast reach real people: show the message and the recipient and wait for the user's yes.

tools.name: line_get_bot_info
tools.description: Basic information about the Official Account behind the token: its bot userId, basic id (@...), display name, picture, chat mode and whether messages are marked as read automatically. Free; a good first call to check the token.

tools.name: line_push_message
tools.description: Send a push message to a specific userId, groupId, or roomId. Counts against the monthly message quota (line_get_message_quota). Use line_reply_message instead whenever you have a fresh replyToken.

to.description: Destination: a userId (U followed by 32 hex characters), groupId (C...) or roomId (R...) from a webhook event or from line_list_follower_ids. Never a display name, and never made up.

messages.description: Array of 1–5 LINE message objects. Simplest text: [{"type": "text", "text": "Hello"}]. See https://developers.line.biz/en/reference/messaging-api/#message-objects for full schema.

items.description: One LINE message object. Every message needs a type; a text message is {"type": "text", "text": "Hello"}.

type.description: Message type. Required on every message.

text.description: For type text: the text, up to 5000 characters.

altText.description: For template, imagemap and flex: the text shown in notifications and chat lists. Required for those types.

contents.description: For flex: a bubble or carousel container ({"type": "bubble", "body": {"type": "box", "layout": "vertical", "contents": [...]}}). Never empty.

notificationDisabled.description: If true, the user is not notified (silent push). Default false.

tools.name: line_reply_message
tools.description: Reply to a message a user just sent, using the replyToken from that webhook event. Free and unlimited (does not count against the push quota). The replyToken is single-use and expires about a minute after the user's message; this connector receives no webhooks, so only call this with a real token the user gave you. Never make one up: without a token use line_push_message.

replyToken.description: The replyToken of a webhook event, exactly as received. Single-use and short-lived. Do not invent or use a placeholder.

items.description: One LINE message object. Every message needs a type; a text message is {"type": "text", "text": "Hello"}.

type.description: Message type. Required on every message.

text.description: For type text: the text, up to 5000 characters.

altText.description: For template, imagemap and flex: the text shown in notifications and chat lists. Required for those types.

contents.description: For flex: a bubble or carousel container ({"type": "bubble", "body": {"type": "box", "layout": "vertical", "contents": [...]}}). Never empty.

notificationDisabled.description: If true, the user is not notified (silent reply). Default false.

tools.name: line_broadcast_message
tools.description: Broadcast a message to ALL friends of the Official Account. Heavy on the monthly push quota (1 message × N friends = N counted pushes). Use sparingly. Returns 202 Accepted; delivery happens asynchronously.

messages.description: Array of 1–5 LINE message objects to broadcast.

items.description: One LINE message object. Every message needs a type; a text message is {"type": "text", "text": "Hello"}.

type.description: Message type. Required on every message.

text.description: For type text: the text, up to 5000 characters.

altText.description: For template, imagemap and flex: the text shown in notifications and chat lists. Required for those types.

contents.description: For flex: a bubble or carousel container ({"type": "bubble", "body": {"type": "box", "layout": "vertical", "contents": [...]}}). Never empty.

notificationDisabled.description: If true, recipients are not notified. Default false.

tools.name: line_get_profile
tools.description: Get a user's display name, profile picture URL, status message and language. Only for users who added the Official Account as a friend. Needs a real userId (U followed by 32 hex characters) from a webhook event or line_list_follower_ids.

userId.description: LINE userId, U followed by 32 hex characters, from a webhook event or line_list_follower_ids. Not a display name; do not guess one.

tools.name: line_get_message_quota
tools.description: The monthly limit of push and broadcast messages of the account: type (none for unlimited, limited) and value, the number of messages per month.

tools.name: line_get_message_quota_consumption
tools.description: How many push and broadcast messages the account has sent this month (totalUsage). Compare with line_get_message_quota before a push or broadcast. Reply messages are not counted.

tools.name: line_list_follower_ids
tools.description: List the userIds of the users who added the Official Account as a friend, up to 1000 per page, to use with line_get_profile or line_push_message. LINE only offers this to verified and premium accounts; other accounts get 403. Users who blocked the account or have not agreed to share their profile are left out.

start.description: Continuation token: the next value from the previous page.
